name: Battlefield Adept
body:
School abjuration; Level bard 2, ranger 2, sorcerer/wizard 3, trainer 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round per 2 levels (maximum 5 rounds)

DESCRIPTION

You gain the benefits of the Dodge, Mobility, and Spring Attack feats for the duration of this spell. If you can cast Battlefield Adept without preparing it first, you can learn feats with Dodge, Mobility, or Spring Attack as a prerequisite, if you meet the other prerequisites to do so. Those feats can only be used while the spell lasts.
